cohort: The study included three consecutive cases of mothers experiencing amniotic fluid embolism (AFE) at a single institution.
finding: The primary finding was that amniotic fluid embolism (AFE)-associated coagulopathy presented with disproportionately low levels of fibrinogen and factor five, and highly elevated d-dimers, while markers of consumptive coagulopathy like platelets and antithrombin were only slightly reduced, supporting hyperfibrinolysis.
